tenacity_and_penetration.description: The core PvP damage adjustment layer. These stats ONLY matter in PvP and follow identical diminishing-returns curves.

tenacity.description: Lowers the opponent's bonus damage (Damage%, Combo DMG%, Skill DMG%, Elemental DMG%, Rage DMG%, etc.)
tenacity.meaning: downT = the percentage of the attacker's bonus damage (S_add) that Tenacity deletes
tenacity.example: If downT = 0.30 (30%), the attacker keeps 70% of their bonus damage layer

penetration.description: Also known as Armor Break. Lowers the opponent's damage reduction (Damage Reduction%, Basic ATK DMG Reduction%, Skill DMG Reduction%, etc.)
penetration.meaning: downP = the percentage of the defender's damage reduction (S_red) that Penetration deletes
penetration.example: If downP = 0.30 (30%), the defender keeps 70% of their damage reduction layer

damage_adjustment_layer.formula: DmgFix = clamp( 1 + S_add × (1 − downT) − S_red × (1 − downP), min, max )

variables.S_add: Sum of all attacker additive damage bonuses: Damage%, Skill Damage%, Combo Damage%, Elemental Damage%, Rage Damage%, Crit Damage% (as bonus over base), etc.
variables.S_red: Sum of all defender damage reduction effects: Damage Reduction%, Basic ATK DMG Reduction%, Skill DMG Reduction%, etc. NOTE: Does NOT include Final Damage Reduction%.
variables.downT: Result from Tenacity formula — % of S_add deleted
variables.downP: Result from Penetration formula — % of S_red deleted
variables.min: Minimum allowed final multiplier (unknown exact value, likely 0.01 or similar)
variables.max: Maximum allowed final multiplier (unknown exact value)

what_they_do_not_affect: Global% stats (Global ATK%, Global HP%, Global DMG%, Global DMG Reduction%)
In-Battle% stats (In-Battle DMG%, In-Battle Skill DMG%, In-Battle Chi DMG%)
Final% DMG or Final% DMG REDUCTION
tenacity_and_penetration.sweet_spot: 3000–7000 difference (Δ). Below = weak. Above = expensive and inefficient.

practical_advice.if_dying_too_fast: Build Tenacity (defender) and Ignore Armor Break / Ignore Penetration (defender). Lowers how hard enemy multipliers hit you.
practical_advice.if_enemies_too_tanky: Build Penetration / Armor Break (attacker) and Ignore Tenacity (attacker). Cuts through their damage reduction.
practical_advice.no_cross_counter: Tenacity does NOT reduce damage reduction. Penetration does NOT reduce damage%. They work on completely separate layers.

suppression_and_ignore_suppression.description: Suppression is an offensive stat from artifact awakening. Ignore Suppression is its defensive counter from mount awakening.

suppression.description: Offensive stat gained through artifact awakening after tier 15
suppression.sources: Artifact Awakening (Orange, Red, Pink, Violet rarities only)
suppression.effect: Scales the attacker's hit in PvP-style damage exchanges

ignore_suppression.description: Defensive counter-stat gained through mount awakening after tier 15
ignore_suppression.sources: Mount Awakening (Red, Pink, Violet rarities only)
ignore_suppression.effect: Cancels the attacker's Suppression on the receiving side

suppression_and_ignore_suppression.note: Green/Blue/Purple mounts and artifacts do NOT gain Suppression or Ignore Suppression. Only Red, Pink, and Violet rarities participate in this layer.

block_mechanic.description: Block is a PvP-relevant defensive stat with its own trigger chance and damage reduction.
block_mechanic.trigger_condition: When your Block value exceeds the target's Block value, 30% chance to trigger Block on incoming hits
block_mechanic.damage_reduction: Reduces DMG by 0.1% per Block point, max 90%
block_mechanic.example: If you have 5000 Block and the attacker has 3000 Block, you have a 30% chance to reduce their damage by min(5000 × 0.1%, 90%) = 50%

shield_vs_skill_shield.description: Two distinct damage-absorption layers with different interactions.

shield.description: The canonical shield mechanic. Adds extra HP layer.
shield.damage_calculation: Damage to Shield is calculated after all damage reduction effects
shield.vulnerable_to: Shield Bonus reduction effects (Qiankun Bag, World within a Bag, Cone Bombing, Demon Evolving Formation)
shield.scaling: Based on Character's Current Max HP

skill_shield.description: A separate shield type that absorbs damage normally
skill_shield.damage_calculation: Absorbs damage normally but ignores Shield Bonus reduction effects entirely
skill_shield.note: Only invest in Shield Bonus reduction if your opponent runs Shield-typed protection rather than Skill Shield

aggro_system.description: Aggro (threat) system works identically in PvP and PvE.
aggro_system.note: Single-target enemy attacks roll against aggro weights. AOE attacks ignore aggro entirely.
aggro_system.tank_strategy: Stack +Aggro on tank slots so they absorb single-target hits
aggro_system.dps_strategy: Spread -Aggro between both DPS slots so they don't get targeted

berserk_stance_pvp.description: Berserk stance trades HP for escalating Basic ATK damage.
berserk_stance_pvp.mechanic: Pays 5% of max HP per basic attack. Gains escalating Basic ATK DMG bonus: +10% per attack, caps at +150% after attack 15. Also adds permanent +2 combo count once crossing attack 6.
berserk_stance_pvp.pvp_recommendation: AVOID Berserk in PvP unless you have shielding or healing. A 30-50% effective max HP cap going into round 2 is a free kill for any Skill DMG comp.
berserk_stance_pvp.where_it_shines: Long single-target boss fights with sustain. Falls off in 2-to-3-attack burst rotations.
berserk_stance_pvp.note: Skill-based DPS doesn't gain from Berserk; the per-attack ramp only multiplies Basic ATK DMG.

pvp_damage_reduction_cap.description: PvP has its own damage reduction cap formula.
pvp_damage_reduction_cap.cap: 75% + enemy DMG (the cap scales with enemy power)
pvp_damage_reduction_cap.note: Unlike PvE where DR caps are fixed per chapter, PvP DR cap increases based on opponent stats

tank_slots.priority_1: Final Damage Reduction (FDR) — cap at 90%, applies after all other reduction
tank_slots.priority_3: Ignore Armor Break / Ignore Penetration — prevents enemies from shredding your DR
tank_slots.priority_6: Shield uptime — pair with aggro so absorbed hits actually get absorbed

dps_slots.priority_1: Penetration / Armor Break — shred enemy DR so your hits stick
dps_slots.priority_2: Ignore Tenacity — prevents enemy Tenacity from deleting your bonus damage
dps_slots.priority_3: Crit Damage — uncapped in crit bracket (up to 500%, 1000% with Super Crit)
dps_slots.priority_6: -Aggro — spread between DPS slots so they don't get targeted

universal_priorities.description: These stats are NOT affected by Tenacity or Penetration, making them extremely reliable in PvP
stats: Final DMG% — no cap, not affected by Tenacity
Global ATK% — multiplicative, not affected by Tenacity
Global HP% — multiplicative, not affected by Penetration
Crit Rate / Crit DMG — not affected by Tenacity
In-Battle DMG% — not affected by Tenacity

top_tier.reason: Prevents enemies from shredding your DR
Prevents enemies from deleting your bonus damage

high_tier.target: Up to 500% cap (1000% with Super Crit)

high_tier.reason: Mirror of Skill Damage for defense

pvp_gem_priorities.note: Community target for Skill Dmg / Skill Dmg Red in PvP: 300/300+

martial_arts_tournament.matchmaking: Servers matched by region tag (GL, JP, KR, TC, AS) and server age
martial_arts_tournament.unlock: Based on server age and account progression

cross_server_guild.matchmaking: Servers grouped by region and age

guild_hegemony.qualification: Only guilds in server group's League Point rankings that finished top placements in Guild League within 4 weeks before event
guild_hegemony.lock_in_rules: Mid-event joiners during Prep Phase excluded. Members must remain in guild from event start.
guild_hegemony.matchmaking: Random each round during active phase. No fixed bracket.

pvp_build_archetypes.name: Skill Burst DPS
pvp_build_archetypes.focus: Maximize skill damage with penetration to shred tanks
pvp_build_archetypes.strategy: Open with high-coefficient rage skill. Penetration ensures it punches through enemy DR.

pvp_build_archetypes.name: Tenacity Tank
pvp_build_archetypes.focus: Survive burst with massive Tenacity and FDR
pvp_build_archetypes.weapon: Blade of Justice or Durian Hammer
pvp_build_archetypes.strategy: Stack Tenacity to 7000+ difference. Enemies' bonus damage gets halved. FDR absorbs what's left.

pvp_build_archetypes.name: Crit Assassin
pvp_build_archetypes.focus: 100% crit with massive crit damage, bypassing Tenacity on crit bracket
pvp_build_archetypes.strategy: Crit Dmg is NOT affected by Tenacity. Stack to 500% cap (1000% with Super Crit).

pvp_build_archetypes.name: Combo Pressure
pvp_build_archetypes.focus: High combo rate with combo damage, sustained DPS
pvp_build_archetypes.strategy: Combo counts as basic attack. High combo rate = constant pressure that ignores some defensive layers.

pvp_build_archetypes.name: Counter Tank
pvp_build_archetypes.strategy: High counter rate + Thorn Shield records damage and fires it back. Best against aggressive opponents.

uncapped_unaffected_stats.description: These stats are completely immune to Tenacity/Penetration and have no known caps

stats.name: Final DMG%
stats.why_strong: Applied last, not reduced by anything

stats.name: Global ATK%
stats.why_strong: Multiplies entire ATK pool, not in S_add

stats.name: Global HP%
stats.why_strong: Multiplies entire HP pool, not in S_red

stats.name: Crit Rate%
stats.why_strong: Determines crit chance, not affected by Tenacity

stats.name: Crit DMG%
stats.why_strong: Determines crit multiplier, not affected by Tenacity

stats.name: Final DMG Red%
stats.why_strong: Applied after all other reduction, 90% cap

sample_pvp_matchup.description: Example calculation showing Tenacity and Penetration in action
sample_pvp_matchup.scenario: Attacker with 3000 Penetration vs Defender with 70% DR and 0 Ignore Penetration

calculation_without_penetration.note: 70% DR means only 30% damage gets through

sample_pvp_matchup.key_takeaway: 3000 Penetration against 70% DR results in a +70% real damage increase, even though Penetration was 'only' deleting 30% of the DR layer.
